title: Every HTML element in a canvas
blurb: Each HTML element, input type and a few attributes, put inside a drawable canvas and measured: is it drawn, can it be hit, does it take real clicks and keys. With one thing to build for each.
question: What does each HTML element do inside a drawable canvas: is it drawn, can it be hit, does it take input?
result: Every element with a box draws and hit tests. Top-layer content (modal dialogs, popovers, the base-select picker) stays outside the canvas, other origins are blank, and the picture is clipped to the element's box.
